thread:
Sam (oncall): Alert: sudden surge of 5xx errors for hosted-api starting ~15:02 UTC. Looking correlated with fallback routing activity. Opening incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/2007654321.
SRE Bot: Alert: api.5xx_rate > 6% (service=hosted-api, region=global). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/fallbacks/fallback-loop?from=now-30m
Olivia (eng-runtime): Seeing repeated fallback attempts to model-compat-v1 with rapid retries from the routing layer. Fallback pool is getting saturated and returning 503s which triggers more fallbacks -> tight feedback loop.
Rex (infra): I can see CPU & queue saturation on the fallback pool nodes. Scaling attempted but autoscaler lagging. Temporarily scaling the pool to +3 nodes and pausing automatic fallback policy rollout.
Priya (support): Customer impact: ~14 tickets mentioning intermittent 5xxs and degraded completions. Two enterprise customers (DataScan, RetailAI) affected. Sending targeted updates and advising retries with exponential backoff.
Sam (oncall): Mitigation: paused automated fallback routing at 15:08 UTC and scaled fallback pool manually. Also applied a short-lived rate cap on fallback requests to prevent amplification. Monitoring now.
Dylan (product): The new fallback policy was meant to broaden model compatibility but had an aggressive immediate-retry setting. We need to revert to the previous policy and add safety thresholds.
Olivia (eng-runtime): After pausing fallback, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in NA by 15:14 UTC, global convergence in progress. Attaching logs and sample request ids to incident doc.
Ops Bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-1500 and linked support cases #5120,#5121,#5122.
Rex (infra): Autoscaler bug root cause: scale-up race when fallback pool reports transient failures; autoscaler lowered target instead of raising it due to a metric normalization bug. Patch PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812.
Priya (support): Sent updates to DataScan & RetailAI with ETA for full recovery and workaround steps.
Sam (oncall): Preliminary RCA: combination of an aggressive retry/fallback policy and an autoscaler metric normalization bug led to a feedback loop saturating fallback capacity.
Sam (oncall): Next steps: 1) revert fallback policy to previous stable settings, 2) ship autoscaler fix + unit tests, 3) add circuit breaker to routing layer to prevent immediate retries, 4) add canary for fallback policy changes and automated rollback on elevated 5xx rate. Postmortem scheduled within 24h: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/2007654321/postmortem.
Dylan (product): I'll prepare the status page copy once the postmortem draft is ready. Proposed status blurb: "Transient 5xx errors caused by an automated fallback policy interacting with autoscaling; mitigation completed and recovery observed."
Sam (oncall): Marking incident mitigated for now. If any residual spikes show up, @here please post in this thread. :white_check_mark:
